# [Block Garden](https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden/)

**Type:** 3D Voxel Sandbox Exploration & Farming Game
**Platform:** Web PWA (Offline-first, desktop & mobile)
**Tech Stack:** Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules), WebGL, Web Components, Signal-based Reactivity, Service Worker
**Play Now:** [https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden/](https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden/)

---

**Block Garden** is a feature-rich 3D voxel sandbox exploration and farming game built with modern vanilla JavaScript.
Players explore procedurally generated worlds, dig for resources, cultivate 20+ plant species, and shape their environment.

Fully playable offline with privacy-first design—no login, no data collection, all progress stored locally or as shareable save files.

---

## 🚀 Development Quick Start

```sh
npm install
npm start              # Dev server on http://localhost:3000
npm test               # Run Jest test suite
npx rollup -c          # Build production bundle
npm run build          # Full build pipeline
```

**Documentation:**
- [**AGENTS.MD**](AGENTS.MD) — Comprehensive architecture & development guide for AI agents
- [**.GITHUB/COPILOT-INSTRUCTIONS.MD**](.github/copilot-instructions.md) — GitHub Copilot coding patterns

---

## 🎮 Gameplay Controls

**Desktop:**
- **Movement:** w/a/s/d | **Camera:** Arrow Keys
- **Jump:** Space | **Descend:** Shift | **Place/Break:** Enter
- **Block Selection:** ~/` | **Inventory:** e/i | **Hotbar:** m | **Flight:** k

**Mobile:**
- **Touch Controls:** Gesture-based movement and block interactions via Hammer.js
- **Camera:** Touch drag | **Actions:** Tap to place blocks, Tap and hold to break blocks

---

## 🧩 Core Features

### World & Environment
- **Procedural Generation** — Simplex noise terrain with shareable seeds (Web Worker-based)
- **Day/Night Cycle** — Dynamic time system with celestial rendering (sun, moon, stars)
- **Ambient Occlusion** — Per-vertex lighting with smooth AO calculations
- **Biome System** — Multiple biomes with unique characteristics
- **Block Variety** — 50+ block types with different properties

### Farming System
- **20+ Plant Species** — Wheat, corn, carrots, pumpkins, roses, sunflowers, bamboo, cacti, trees, mushrooms, water plants, and more
- **Growth Stages** — Plants progress through realistic growth cycles
- **Harvesting** — Collect mature crops and seeds
- **Plant Persistence** — Growth state saved and restored with world

### Storage & Progression
- **Local Saves** — All progress stored in IndexedDB with compression
- **Shareable Files** — Export/import worlds as downloadable PDF files
- **Share Target Protocol** — PWA share integration for save files
- **Cloud-Free** — Privacy-first design with zero cloud dependencies

### UI & Interaction
- **Inventory System** — Manage collected blocks and seeds
- **Material Bar** — Quick-access hotbar for block selection
- **Color Customization** — Full theming system with custom color properties
- **Tutorial** — "Getting Started" dialog for new players
- **Dialogs** — Storage management, inventory, settings, examples, about, privacy

### Cross-Platform Support
- **Desktop** — Keyboard & mouse controls with lock-on-canvas
- **Mobile** — Touch and gesture controls via Hammer.js
- **PWA** — Installation support, offline play, Service Worker caching
- **Responsive** — Auto-scaling canvas for any screen size

---

## 🏛️ Architecture Overview

### Core Systems (src/core/)
- **Game Loop** (systems/game/loop.mjs) — Fixed-timestep update loop
- **State Management** (systems/game/state.mjs) — Signal-based reactive state with Signal.State and Signal.Computed
- **World System** (world/chunkManager.mjs) — Chunk loading/unloading, lifecycle, persistence
- **Physics** (systems/physics.mjs) — AABB collision detection and response
- **Lighting** (world/lighting/lightSystem.mjs) — Dynamic light propagation with 8-directional updates
- **Plant Growth** (systems/plantGrowth.mjs) — Age progression, harvesting, restoration
- **Meshing** (world/meshing/chunkMesher.mjs) — Greedy algorithm for efficient quad generation
- **Rendering** (render/graphics.mjs) — WebGL pipeline with three render passes (opaque, transparent, water)

### UI System (src/ui/)
- **BlockGarden Component** (BlockGarden.mjs) — Main Web Component with Shadow DOM
- **Controls** (controls/) — Event listeners for canvas, keyboard, mouse, touch, Hammer.js gestures
- **Dialogs** (dialog/) — Modular dialog systems for inventory, storage, settings, tutorials, sharing
- **Components** (components/) — Custom form elements (select, option)
- **Material Bar** (materialBar.mjs) — Block selection interface

### Public API (src/api/)
- **BlockGarden API** (BlockGarden.mjs) — Extensible API for modding and scripting
- **Player Control** (player/) — Programmatic movement, key events, animations
- **UI Utilities** (ui/) — Canvas resizing, toast notifications
- **Examples** (examples/) — Game of Life, Fireworks, TicTacToe, Video Player, Photo Gallery, Link, Messaging, Konami Code

### Utilities (src/utils/)
- **Colors** (colors/) — CSS color manipulation, theming, custom properties, normalization
- **Interaction** (interaction.mjs) — Mining, placing, farming logic
- **Raycasting** (raycastFromCanvasCoords.mjs) — Mouse/touch to world conversion
- **Math/Ray/Noise** — Math utilities, ray calculations, noise functions
- **Compression** — Data serialization and gzip compression
- **Canvas** — PNG export with game state metadata

### Configuration (src/core/world/config/)
- **Blocks** (blocks.mjs) — 1300+ lines defining all block types and properties
- **Colors** (colors.mjs) — Color palettes and theming
- **Biomes** (biomes.mjs) — Biome definitions with characteristics
- **Block Database** (index.mjs) — Unified block metadata and lookup

### Build & Tooling
- **Rollup** (rollup.config.mjs) — ES module bundling with tree-shaking
- **Jest** (jest.config.mjs) — Comprehensive test suite (~3000+ tests)
- **Service Worker** (service-worker/) — Workbox configuration, share target handler
- **Build Scripts** (bin/) — HTML building, compression, analysis, serving utilities

## 🧠 Modding & Extension

Block Garden is designed for openness. Extend gameplay through:

- **Bookmarklet Scripts** — Run custom scripts in the browser console
- **API Examples** — Modular JavaScript examples in the examples gallery
- **Public API** — Access to player control, canvas utilities, and game state
- **Web Components** — Build custom UI components using Shadow DOM

**Resources:**
- [**API Examples Gallery**](https://kherrick.github.io/block-garden/src/api/examples/) — Live examples
- [**Public API Docs**](src/api/BlockGarden.mjs) — Full API reference
- [**AGENTS.MD**](AGENTS.MD) — For AI agents building on Block Garden

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

- **Rendering:** WebGL with vertex lighting and custom shader compilation
- **Reactivity:** signal-polyfill (Signal.State, Signal.Computed) for fine-grained state management
- **UI:** Web Components with Shadow DOM encapsulation, CSS custom properties (variables)
- **Architecture:** Vanilla JavaScript ES Modules (.mjs), no frameworks
- **Testing:** Jest with ES module support
- **Bundling:** Rollup with tree-shaking optimization
- **Procedural Gen:** Simplex noise in Web Worker for non-blocking terrain generation
- **Storage:** localforage (IndexedDB) with gzip compression
- **Input Handling:** Keyboard, mouse, touch (Hammer.js), accessibility features
- **PWA:** Service Worker (Workbox), manifest, add-to-home-screen support
- **Data Format:** Custom compressed save format, PDF embedding for sharing

---

## 📋 Testing

- **Test Framework:** Jest
- **Coverage:** Comprehensive unit, integration, and reproduction tests
- **Run Tests:** npm test or npm test -- --watch for watch mode
- **Test Files:** Collocated with sources as .test.mjs files
